goal: Exempt the non-required Documents-only merge authorization routing diagnostic from the guarded-merge committed-mirror preflight so code pull requests can merge again.
prohibited_actions: Do not modify a migration or any database state.
Do not exempt any context that appears in the required-checks mirror.
Do not claim an author lane, preview, or production lane.
assumptions: Documents-only merge authorization is a routing diagnostic and is not a required status context in branch protection or the committed mirror.
stop_conditions: Stop if implementation requires a database or production write.
Stop if the exemption would cover a context present in the required-checks mirror.
